subject: Vendor bootstrapping — purchase id assignment & pricing matrix
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan@acmebay.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmebay.io
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — onboarding paperwork + initial pricing

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Attached is our completed onboarding packet (vendor_onboarding_form.pdf). A few open items from our side:

- Tax ID: 98-7654321 (we'll attach signed W-9 in a follow-up).
- Initial pricing tiers: see the matrix on page 3 of the packet — our list shows quantity breaks that should be mapped to separate PO lines if Redwood needs line-level pricing caps.
- Start date: we can accept orders starting 10/1 once the PO is in place.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will issue a provisional PO or a permanent PO number and how spend caps are applied across multi-line purchases? We're ready to sign the DocuSign envelope once the PO number and spend cap are confirmed.

Thanks —
Jordan
Head of Operations
AcmeBay
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 412KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — onboarding paperwork + initial pricing

Thanks Jordan — looping in procurement to confirm the PO flow. Ben / team, next steps from our side:

1) Confirm vendor Tax ID + upload W-9 to the vendor record.
2) Decide PO number pattern. For new vendors we typically use PO-<VENDCODE>-<sequential>. Suggest PO-ACB-##### for AcmeBay.
3) Pricing tiers: Because AcmeBay's pricing changes at the quantity break, we should split the order into two line items so each tier has its own unit price and spend tracking. If Redwood needs a single spend cap (annual), we'll tie the cap to the vendor ledger and still track per-line burn.

Can you ask Jordan to send the signed W-9 and confirm the "tier threshold" quantities so we can prepare the corrected line item CSV?

Monica Patel
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
[Internal note: will need ledger code 2045-ACQ for this account]

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan@acmebay.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — onboarding paperwork + initial pricing

Monica / Ben —

Attached: signed_w9.pdf and an updated pricing matrix (see page 2). Tier thresholds are: 1-499 units @ $12.50, 500-1999 @ $11.00, 2000+ @ $9.75.

We prefer a single annual spend cap rather than per-PO caps; $75,000 looks reasonable for initial fiscal year. Please go ahead and provision the vendor record and assign the PO number. I'll sign the DocuSign once I see the PO referenced in the envelope.

Jordan
[Attachment: signed_w9.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan@acmebay.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor bootstrapping — purchase id assignment & pricing matrix

Jordan —

Thanks — we've ingested the W-9 and updated the vendor profile. Procurement assigned the internal ledger and suggested the line split to match your tiers. Our decisions:

- Assigned PO: PO-ACB-00542 (per suggested pattern). This will be the master PO for initial onboarding.
- Spend cap: annual cap set to $75,000 (will appear on the vendor ledger).
- Line items: Procurement will issue two physical PO lines in the system to capture the two pricing tiers (1-499 and 500+). Finance requested that we keep the original master PO number and add suffixes to lines (PO-ACB-00542-L1, PO-ACB-00542-L2) — procurement to reissue.

I've attached the corrected_line_items.csv with the proposed line splits and unit prices. Please confirm that the L2 threshold (500 units) is correct — Jordan confirmed 500.

DocuSign: I'll send an envelope that references PO-ACB-00542 once procurement finalizes the line rows (https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-ACB-9981).

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: corrected_line_items.csv (CSV, 5KB)]
